categories.name: monetary policy
categories.definition: Government bank directed policy on the amount of money in circulation and the rate at which it can be loaned
categories.modelLabel: central bank monetary policy, interest rates and money supply

categories.name: inflation
categories.definition: The overall increase in prices and cost of living throughout an economy
categories.modelLabel: inflation and economy-wide increases in prices and living costs

categories.name: recession
categories.definition: A decrease in gross domestic product over a period of two quarters in a row
categories.modelLabel: economic recession and sustained decline in GDP

categories.name: government debt
categories.definition: Debt incurred when a country borrows funds to pay for public services and projects that it cannot afford based on the amount of taxes it has raised
categories.modelLabel: government debt and public borrowing

categories.name: gross domestic product
categories.definition: A measure of a region's economic performance, commonly abbreviated as GDP
categories.modelLabel: gross domestic product (GDP) and national economic output

categories.name: unemployment
categories.definition: The state of being available to work but not having a job
categories.modelLabel: unemployment and people unable to find jobs

categories.name: government budget
categories.definition: The proposed expenses and revenues approved by the legislature.
categories.modelLabel: government budgets, planned public spending and revenues

categories.name: taxation policy
categories.definition: Government programs and policies around the taxation of citizens and entities
categories.modelLabel: taxation policy and government taxes on people and businesses

categories.name: banking
categories.definition: Financial institutions and services for storing, transmitting, receiving and delivering money
categories.modelLabel: banking institutions and services for deposits, payments and money transfers

categories.name: stocks and securities
categories.definition: Financial instruments such as company shares and bonds
categories.modelLabel: stocks, bonds and other financial securities

categories.name: corporate earnings
categories.definition: Announcements and discussions of corporate earnings
categories.modelLabel: corporate earnings announcements and company profit results

categories.name: bankruptcy
categories.definition: News about actual bankruptcy filings.
categories.modelLabel: companies filing for bankruptcy

categories.name: merger or acquisition
categories.definition: Two or more companies forming a new company mergers, takeovers or acquisitions.
categories.modelLabel: company mergers, acquisitions and takeovers

categories.name: layoffs and downsizing
categories.definition: Planned or actual reductions in the labor force.
categories.modelLabel: employer layoffs and planned workforce reductions

categories.name: labor strike
categories.definition: Groups of employees agreeing to cease work activities with the aim of achieving better pay or work conditions
categories.modelLabel: labor strikes in which employees stop working over pay or conditions

categories.name: antitrust regulations
categories.definition: laws to promote competition between companies for the benefit of consumers
categories.modelLabel: antitrust laws and regulation of competition between companies

categories.name: oil and gas
categories.definition: The exploration, extraction, refining, transporting and marketing of petroleum products and natural gas
categories.modelLabel: petroleum and natural gas exploration, production, refining, transport and sales

categories.name: electricity
categories.definition: The power line distribution system and the sale of electrical power at wholesale and retail levels
categories.modelLabel: electric power grids, distribution and electricity sales

categories.name: renewable energy
categories.definition: Energy derived from sustainable sources
categories.modelLabel: renewable energy from sustainable sources

categories.name: nuclear power
categories.definition: Use of radioactive materials for power production
categories.modelLabel: nuclear power production using radioactive materials

categories.name: agriculture
categories.definition: The growing and raising of plants and animals for consumption and the processing, cleaning, packing or storage of these products
categories.modelLabel: agriculture, farming, livestock and agricultural products

categories.name: metal and mineral mining and refining
categories.definition: The extractive businesses that remove raw materials, including coal, gold iron and copper, from the earth by drilling and pumping, quarrying or mining
categories.modelLabel: mining and extraction of metals, minerals and coal

categories.name: construction and property
categories.definition: All items pertaining to the construction and sale of property
categories.modelLabel: construction of buildings and the sale of real estate

categories.name: waterway and maritime transport
categories.definition: Commercial movement of people or goods via boats, ships and water
categories.modelLabel: commercial shipping and transport of passengers or goods by water

categories.name: artificial intelligence
categories.definition: An attempt to let computers simulate how the human brain works by applying statistical, heuristic or machine learning methods and algorithms to large datasets. Enables a long range of automatic functions like image recognition and categorization.
categories.modelLabel: artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies

categories.name: semiconductor and electronic component
categories.definition: The basic components that together create working electronic devices such as computer chips, transistors, diodes and integrated circuits
categories.modelLabel: semiconductors, computer chips and electronic components

categories.name: software and applications
categories.definition: Computer programs including mobile or web apps and operating systems
categories.modelLabel: computer software, applications and operating systems

categories.name: cyber crime
categories.definition: Criminal activities carried out by means of computers or the internet, such as hacking, phishing scams and identity theft
categories.modelLabel: cybercrime using computers or the internet, including hacking and phishing

categories.name: pharmaceutical
categories.definition: The production of medicines from various chemicals and natural substances and the research and discovery around new medications
categories.modelLabel: pharmaceutical medicines, drug development and manufacturing

categories.name: medical research
categories.definition: Investigation conducted in the fields of health and medicine, such as genetic studies, disease research or pharmaceutical drug trials
categories.modelLabel: medical research, disease studies and clinical trials

categories.name: climate change
categories.definition: All issues relating to extreme changes in climate, including rising global temperature, debate on the causes and solutions of global warming, greenhouse gases and ways to reduce emissions
categories.modelLabel: climate change, global warming and greenhouse gas emissions

categories.name: environmental pollution
categories.definition: The contamination of natural resources by harmful substances
categories.modelLabel: environmental pollution and contamination of natural resources

categories.name: election
categories.definition: The selection of government representatives by the casting of votes by the populace
categories.modelLabel: political elections and voting for government representatives

categories.name: national security
categories.definition: The protection of a political entity
categories.modelLabel: national security and protection of the state

categories.name: armed conflict
categories.definition: Disputes between opposing groups involving the use of weapons, but not necessarily formally declared wars
categories.modelLabel: armed conflicts, warfare and fighting between armed groups

categories.name: diplomacy
categories.definition: Negotiations between representatives of nations or groups of nations and the diplomats who are involved in the talks
categories.modelLabel: diplomacy and negotiations between countries

categories.name: economic sanction
categories.definition: Economic measures taken by one country or intergovernmental agency against another such as trade restrictions and embargoes
categories.modelLabel: economic sanctions, embargoes and restrictions against countries

categories.name: trade policy
categories.definition: Governmental decisions on tariffs, shipping, embargoes, and the types of goods and services to be imported and exported
categories.modelLabel: international trade policy, tariffs and import or export rules

categories.name: trade agreements
categories.definition: Agreements between countries or trading blocs for the sale and purchase of goods and services
categories.modelLabel: trade agreements between countries or trading blocs

categories.name: protests and demonstrations
categories.definition: A non-violent public show of support for or opposition to a cause, idea or policy, in the form of a mass meeting or march
categories.modelLabel: peaceful public protests, demonstrations and marches

selectionRationale: Economic media monitoring; selected for product relevance, not per-category measured performance. Display groups are not IPTC hierarchy. Multi-label; allow no labels. Original names retained for controlled comparison.
wordingNote: Assistant paraphrases of official definitions, fixed before inference. Development experiment after reviewing previous errors, not held-out evidence.
